title: Post-lock discharge availability audit and registered modern diagnostics
purpose: Audit whether pre-2006 observations exist, and after the hydrology product is immutable recompute the registered modern and four-station diagnostics. This stage cannot select or alter the model.

observation_policy.first_access: Only after the Stage 35 product and hash lock exist
observation_policy.period: Audit 1961-2005 availability; the current authoritative archive contains 0 pre-2006 records and therefore cannot provide historical performance metrics
observation_policy.station_exclusion: No performance-based exclusions; only pre-existing documented identity/QC exclusions are allowed and must be reported

reporting_strata: 2010-2018 previously calibrated station locations, reported as in-sample diagnostic only
Completely held-out spatial stations 珠坑, 昭平, 瓦村（二）, 盘江桥（三） using their locked retrospective observations
metrics: monthly signed bias and flow-regime diagnostics
fast/slow fractions as modeled diagnostics only
failure_behavior: Report degradation or nonstationarity transparently; do not reopen parameter fitting in this program
